stage: Stage 13: Lead time per supplier in Purchasing
note: 1.12 moves displayed lead times only. Under any supplier but an item's usual (effective) one, a lead set on the item is replaced by that supplier's own figure (Allied's on the Suppliers page, else the measured median, else none): leadTimeDays, leadTimeSetByAllied, leadTimeOrders and leadTimeSameDayExcluded on those /cart lines and compare options, and rationale.leadTimeDays (the line's own lead) with them. Every line and option gains leadTimeSource (item / supplier / measured, null with none). Nothing else may move: quantities, suggestions, rationale.leadTimeDaysUsed, costs, states, totals, supplier cards (their leadTimeDays is the supplier's and always was), items, item pages, cart.csv and every other file are unchanged. The wildcards below would let a lead move on any record, so the record-level proof is `stage-check leads <before> <after>`: the rows that moved equal the rows predicted from <before>, and every non-lead /cart field is identical.
